follow_up.reason: The unique model and chart work includes seven accepted child tasks. The standard workflow passed, but the M4-006 Ubuntu selection failed and a bounded test reproduced foreground source selection losing admission to a background read.
The four original update proposals failed on both platforms. Two proposed unreviewed Action pins and two lost the previous checkpoint after a Dependabot force push.

compatibility_review.market_worker: Protocol 1.0 still supports two reads. Keep the explicit compatibility contract and independent wire expectations. M1-027 removes the duplicated production list.
compatibility_review.user_data: Versioned workspace migrations, archived receipt readers and frozen revision handling still serve observable stored inputs. Their compatibility coverage remains required.
compatibility_review.temporary_primary_alias: The guarded watcher observed its owner release on 2026-11-21. The previous link was absent at this review and the original observation was independently retained.
